sub_questions.question: What happens once the Sandbox workspace's 200 credits run out — does the app stop working?

claims.claim: Model calls that rely on Dify-hosted credits stop working once the credits are used up.
claims.guide_evidence: Once a workspace's credits are used up, model calls on Dify-hosted credits stop working

claims.claim: Sandbox's 200 credits are one-time and do not reset.

claims.guide_evidence: waits for the next monthly credit reset (paid plans) — Sandbox credits do not reset

claims.claim: Connecting your own provider API key keeps the app running, with calls billed directly by that provider instead of using Dify credits.
claims.guide_evidence: calls to that provider's models are billed directly by the provider and no longer draw down the workspace's Dify message credits

claims.claim: Upgrading to Professional gives 5,000 credits per month that renew.

evaluation.rationale: Every claim is backed by the guide: once credits are used up, calls on Dify-hosted credits stop working, Sandbox credits are one-time and don't reset, you can connect your own provider key to keep things running, and Professional comes with 5,000 credits a month that reset monthly. The answer says the credits "renew each billing cycle," while the guide says they reset monthly. For monthly billing these mean the same thing. The answer fully answers Dana's question, so no escalation is needed and it's safe to send.
